review.notes: Scan PDF: Genius Expert Editor is a local-first document scanner and editor. There is no account, sign-in, analytics SDK, document backend, or document upload: documents are stored on-device (Hive plus the app documents directory), and text recognition runs on-device through the native iOS Vision framework. Network access is limited to user-initiated App Store purchase and restore actions and external support, privacy, terms, review, and subscription-management links. The library is intentionally empty on first launch. To create a document, tap the large orange camera button, capture a sheet of paper, and tap Save; Photos and Files imports are also available. Search finds documents by title, folder, and recognized text. The optional Plus auto-renewable monthly subscription uses product ID plus_pdf_monthly at $3.99/month, with a 3-day introductory trial to be configured in App Store Connect. It unlocks reusable saved signatures and priority support; drawing and applying a new signature each time remains free. The full scanner, editor, search, and export flow remains usable without subscribing. The paywall is available from Settings > Upgrade to Plus and the saved-signature action. Restore Purchases is available on the paywall and under Settings > Subscription. In-App Event: scanpdf://receipt-rescue opens the free Receipt Rescue Challenge with no purchase or login. The event window is 2026-08-17 through 2026-09-17 at 23:59, and the goal is 15 receipts. Game Center is enabled for this version as requested; there are no leaderboards or achievements in v1.

en-US.description:
Scan PDF: Genius Expert Editor turns your iPhone into a fast, precise paper scanner and a full document workbench. Point the camera at any page — a contract, a receipt, a whiteboard, an ID, a handwritten note — and it becomes a clean, straightened, shareable PDF in seconds.

SCAN ANYTHING
Open the scanner with one tap and capture a single page or a whole batch. Adjust the crop with draggable corners and the page is automatically de-skewed with perspective correction, so photographed paper comes out looking flat and printed. Six processing filters — Auto Color, Original, Black & White, Grayscale, Lighten, and High Contrast — clean up shadows, ink, and paper tone. Rotate, reorder, add, and delete pages before saving.

FIND EVERYTHING WITH TEXT RECOGNITION
On-device text recognition reads your scans automatically, so the search bar finds documents by title, folder, or the words INSIDE them. Type a phrase from a receipt and the receipt appears. Open the recognized text for any document, copy it, or export it as a plain text file. Recognition runs entirely on your iPhone.

EDIT LIKE AN EXPERT
Sign documents by drawing your signature with a finger, then drag and pinch it into place — it is baked directly into the page. Merge two documents into one PDF. Rename, duplicate pages into new files via merge, organize everything into folders, and switch between grid and list views with sorting by date created, date modified, or name. Deleted documents wait in the Trash Bin until you restore or remove them for good.

EXPORT ANYWHERE
Every document exports as a PDF, as JPG or PNG images, or as recognized text — and prints directly to any AirPrint printer. Import existing photos from your library or PDF and image files from the Files app; imported PDFs are converted into editable page-based documents so all the same tools work on them.

RECEIPT RESCUE CHALLENGE
Thermal receipts fade to blank within months. During the limited-time Receipt Rescue Challenge, scan fifteen paper receipts — warranties, refunds, expense records — into permanent PDFs before the ink disappears, and watch the live rescue counter climb.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-in. Your documents never leave your iPhone unless you choose to share or export them. Everything — files, folders, recognized text — is stored on-device.

SCAN PDF PLUS
The optional Plus subscription (3-day free trial, then $3.99 per month, cancel any time in App Store settings) adds reusable saved signatures and priority support. The full scanner, editor, search, and export toolkit above is free — Plus is a convenience, never a wall.

Whether you are digitizing a filing cabinet, capturing receipts on a business trip, or signing and returning a form in under a minute, Scan PDF: Genius Expert Editor keeps the flow simple: scan, perfect, save, find, send.
